# Casa Lumbre

> Casa Lumbre is a design concept for a 12-room boutique hotel in a 19th-century townhouse in Málaga old town, Spain. It is a portfolio demo by Lizzy Cruz, not a real hotel: no bookings are taken and prices are examples.

The site is available in Spanish (default) and English. Each room page lists guests, size, bed type, view, amenities, check-in and check-out times, and a demo booking form.

## Pages (English)

- [Home](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/en/): the house, rooms, experiences, direct-booking benefits and location
- [Patio Room](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/en/rooms/patio/): 2 guests, 22 m², queen bed, courtyard view, from €165 a night
- [Balcony Room](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/en/rooms/balcony/): 2 guests, 26 m², queen bed, juliet balcony, from €185 a night
- [Lumbre Suite](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/en/rooms/lumbre-suite/): 2–3 guests, 42 m², king bed, private terrace, from €290 a night

## Páginas (Español)

- [Inicio](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/)
- [Habitación Patio](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/habitaciones/patio/)

- [Suite Lumbre](https://casa-lumbre.pages.dev/habitaciones/suite-lumbre/)

## Optional

- Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00. Breakfast is included on direct bookings.
- Address (fictional): Calle de la Lumbre 12, 29008 Málaga, Spain
